detail: The first final-gates execution reused the prior run's gate wrappers (operational_resume_44700681660.run_nested_guard / run_state_gate), which bind --run-id to their own module constant '44700681660'. The nested-refs record was therefore written as 44700681660_nested_evidence_refs.json inside THIS run's results directory and both gate records stamped run_id=44700681660, while final_gates.json cited the record path 44708758013_nested_evidence_refs.json (non-existent) - a broken evidence pointer for an auditor. The gate SEMANTICS are unchanged: the same frozen nested_evidence_refs_guard and state_integrity_gate modules ran over the same state files; both attempt-1 runs returned NESTED_REFS_RESOLVED (0 unresolved) and ALL_CHECKS_PASS (11/11). No measurement, no frozen bar, rubric, threshold, gate predicate or verdict contract is touched.
